package.name: san_reroute_planner
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — Tier 1.5 AUTO_REROUTE planner (SDD-SWARM §6.4). Cost path checker + lateral evasion ±2m. Owns KPP-2 (회피 반응 ≤ 300ms) E2E measurement. Pure-logic core is standalone-testable; rclcpp wrapper publishes obstacle_on_path + /cmd_vel.
Soft Kill 제외 적용 — RF 재머 통합 없음. Hard kill 경로 (san_fire_authorization) 와 독립적으로 동작.
